$comment: Log groups that are known noise and must not reach triage.
`pattern` is a plain substring matched against a group's first message
line (the same string used as its grouping key). Keep patterns narrow —
a broad one silences future real failures too.
Adding an entry is a deliberate act: it means 'we looked, and this can
never indicate a problem'. If something is merely usually-harmless,
leave it in and let triage judge it in context. /log-triage may propose
additions, but a human reviews the diff.
Note that GET requests are already excluded at query time in
scripts/log-triage-fetch.ts, which removes most post-deploy sweep noise
before grouping. These rules cover what survives that.

rules.pattern: The request was not authenticated. Either allow unauthenticated invocations
rules.reason: Cloud Run rejecting an unauthenticated probe of a non-public function. Emitted by the platform for any internet scan; nothing of ours ran.
firebase-functions rejecting a non-POST on a callable. Only reachable by a client calling the endpoint wrongly; the platform already returned 400.

rules.pattern: Error: Invalid request, unable to process.
rules.reason: The ERROR that firebase-functions logs itself right after 'Request has invalid method'. Same event, second log line; severity is the library's choice, not ours.
Our api/admin Express handlers rejecting an unauthenticated request. Expected for any unauthenticated probe; a real auth regression shows up as failing user journeys, not as this line.
